title: Retry storm and circuit breaker — dependency overload

experiment.question: How do timeouts and retries amplify offered load, and can a breaker contain calls to a failing dependency?
controls: Inject dependency errors or slow service

inputs.name: offeredRps
inputs.source: Breakscale upstream challenge 'Stop the storm' load; not source system requirements.

inputs.name: dependencyErrorRate
inputs.reason: Fault-injection starting point; vary it deliberately.

inputs.name: timeoutMs
inputs.reason: Upstream challenge narrative; not a production timeout.

inputs.name: retries
inputs.reason: Upstream challenge narrative; not a production retry policy.

safety: Simulated retry/failure behaviour only; it cannot validate downstream side effects, idempotency, payment safety or real provider failure semantics.
